description: A woman around thirty with a bright yet soft and warm voice, a native Filipino speaker with Manila Tagalog pronunciation and clear diction. Gentle, devout and natural, speaking at an ordinary relaxed pace with natural pitch movement.
ref_text: Luwalhati sa Ama, at sa Anak, at sa Espiritu Santo. Kapara noong unang-una, ngayon at magpakailanman, at magpasawalang hanggan. Amen.
